episodes.165097: Heavy precipitation occurred across northern portions of the SGX CWA from December 28-30. Widespread precipitation amounts greater than 1 inch occurred across Orange and San Bernardino Counties, with 2 to 3 feet of snow reported in the San Bernardino County Mountains.

events.narrative: Widespread rainfall reports of 2 to 5 inches, locally higher across Orange County through the duration of the event.
Widespread rainfall reports of 2 to 5 inches, locally higher across San Bernardino County through the duration of the event.
